llm_response.reason: The website shows multiple strong scam indicators: it promises unrealistic returns (up to 80%), instant withdrawals, and guaranteed ROI; uses unverified testimonials; presents vague and unverifiable company information; pushes a referral program and copy trading targeted at psychological weaknesses; operates with cryptocurrency as the main payment method; and has ambiguous privacy policy statements. It matches several listed investment scam characteristics, including excessive urgency, lack of transparency on company legitimacy, unusual payment methods, and fake testimonials.
